correctness.rationale: The full conditional-renewal identity is exact for every horizon. Truncated moment concentration plus exponential Markov domination establishes a triangular integrated-renewal estimate; the geometric-mixture identity and log-convexity induction produce monotone renewal masses, permitting a local estimate. The resulting logarithmic backward age is exponentially tilted on (0,1). The spectral weak ballistic law, with only an atom of mass W at zero velocity and fixed-site flat-band mass W, promotes the age law to the claimed logarithmic-position mixture. All parameters, endpoint contributions and scope are controlled analytically. The standalone script passes separately implemented finite Fourier-projector and renewal-convolution diagnostics; no unproved infinite claim rests solely on numerics.

value.rationale: The restart exponent s=2 separates infinite and finite mean waiting times and therefore has a physically natural inverse-logarithmic finite-observation window. The result is a normalized nontrivial distribution of transport exponents with a parameter-controlled tilt and a separate coin-dependent localization atom. It clarifies behavior unresolved by the motivating fixed-exponent or weak-geometric-reset results and applies to arbitrary normalized coin states, giving both active and dark preparations. The fact concerns a motivated critical window rather than a selected finite numerical coefficient; it neither claims nor needs a complete microscopic position-density law.
